title: The epoch walk

members.role: the first era is shaded behind the line and named on the word that names it
what the first era did is lit on its own words - the fall out of it
the line is carried on to the next era as the sentence reaches it
the second era is shaded and named on its word - after the first, never with it

does: One long line walks its named eras in turn: the first shaded and named, its fall lit, the line carried on, then the next era shaded and named - never two at once.

use_when.act: SPANS - named periods on one long series (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R22)
use_when.shape: series + named periods: one long line whose eras the sentence names one after another
use_when.use: a sentence that walks eras ('In two thousand the internet ... then the tower came down ... AI spending just crossed'): each era shaded and named on its word, in turn
use_when.dont: eras lit at once (the guide's don't); an era's name that carries a number the page does not draw (E77 - H row 9's 7 / 8 are not on the object); a period renamed in place is A44's swap, not a new span
